scope_limits: Source-only fixture, not a canonical runtime WorkRecord/store or live strategy.

Missing effort/time ranges, complexity/difficulty grades and uncertainty are Unassessed; none becomes zero, low or a computed route distance.

Groups do not duplicate shared work or replace either dependency kind.
